units.source_text: 风吹过来，像要从嘴里扼住他的气息似的。

en.t: The wind blew toward him, as if it were choking off his breath from inside his mouth.

units.source_text: 他在洞的边缘兜了一圈，往看得见海的地方登了上去。

en.t: He made a circuit around the edge of the hole, then climbed up to a place where he could see the sea.
The sea, too, was yellow and murky.

units.source_text: 他深深地吸了一口气，嘴里只有粗糙不平的感觉，并没有他所预期的那种滋味。

en.t: He drew in a deep breath, but his mouth held only a rough, gritty sensation, not the taste he had expected.

units.source_text: 回过头来，村头，腾起了一片沙尘。

en.t: When he turned back, a cloud of sand dust was rising at the edge of the village.

units.source_text: 那大概是载着女人的三轮摩托车吧。

en.t: That was probably the three-wheeled motorcycle carrying the woman.

units.source_text: ……是呵，分别之前，要是把陷阱的实貌告诉她该多好呵。

en.t: ... Yes, before they parted, how good it would have been if he had told her the true nature of the trap.
